query: UPDATE imap_accounts SET state=$6,revision=revision+1,lease_until=now()+interval '5 minutes',updated_at=now() WHERE link_id=$1 AND sync_generation=$2 AND grant_generation=$3 AND lease_id=$4 AND revision=$5 AND lease_until>now() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links l WHERE l.id=imap_accounts.link_id AND l.macro_id=imap_accounts.user_id AND l.provider='IMAP' AND l.is_sync_active AND NOT l.needs_reauth AND l.sync_generation=imap_accounts.sync_generation AND l.grant_generation=imap_accounts.grant_generation) RETURNING revision
